# Termux-Diffusion Full Technical Specification (v1.1.1)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Native On-Device Stable Diffusion Runtime for Android Termux & ARM64
Executes quantized Stable Diffusion models directly on Android Bionic libc with NEON SIMD vector acceleration and direct Samsung Gallery indexing.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-diffusion
- Command: pip install termux-diffusion
# or: npm install termux-diffusion
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Zero-PRoot Native ARM64 Bionic**: Executes directly without root permissions, virtual machines, or PRoot Linux overhead.
- **Dual Python & Node.js Engine**: Provides comprehensive CLI and programmatic APIs across both Python and JavaScript.
- **Samsung Gallery Auto-Indexing**: Automatically broadcasts Android MEDIA_SCANNER intents to register generated art in Gallery.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import termux_diffusion as td

# 1. Generate image on Android hardware
image_path = td.generate(
    prompt="Cyberpunk Seoul city at night, neon lights, 8k",
    model="sd-turbo",
    steps=4
)
print(f"Generated and saved to Gallery: {image_path}")

```
